clauses.name: 核心被动：热夜初拥
clauses.text:
每消耗25点能量，获得1点<Term:1000039></Term>，<color=#FFFFFF>[风能]</color>上限为3点；
洛克茜的初始<color=#FFFFFF>能量自动回复</color>大于1.2时，超过部分每超过0.01，攻击力提升5点，最多提升<color=#2BAD00>480</color>点，冲击力提升0.4点，最多提升<color=#2BAD00>40</color>点；
<color=#FFFFFF>[特殊技：恕不远送]</color>命中处于<color=#FFFFFF>[风化]</color>状态中的敌人后，会触发<Term:1000038></Term>，<color=#FFFFFF>[浸染]</color>状态被还原；
队伍中任意队友触发<color=#FFFFFF>[浸染]</color>或<color=#FFFFFF>[净化]</color>效果时，洛克茜将根据<color=#FFFFFF>[浸染]</color>或<color=#FFFFFF>[净化]</color>的属性为全队角色提供增益效果：洛克茜每拥有1%暴击率，非<color=#FFFFFF>[锋御]</color>角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，暴击伤害提升0.4%，最多提升<color=#2BAD00>22%</color>；<color=#FFFFFF>[锋御]</color>角色造成对应属性以及风属性伤害时，锐暴伤害提升0.2%，最多提升<color=#2BAD00>10%</color>；每个属性增益效果分别持续50秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；
对已经处于<color=#FFFFFF>[风化]</color>状态下的敌人再次施加<color=#FFFFFF>[风化]</color>时，根据被覆盖的<color=#FFFFFF>[风化]</color>状态下的<color=#FFFFFF>[浸染]</color>属性及风属性，全队角色同样可以获得该增益效果。

clauses.name: Core Passive: Warm Night's Embrace
clauses.text:
Gain 1 point of <Term:1000039></Term> for every 25 Energy consumed, up to a maximum of 3 <color=#FFFFFF>Wind Energy</color>.
When Roxy's initial <color=#FFFFFF>Energy Regen</color> exceeds 1.2, for every 0.01 above this value, ATK increases by 5, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>480</color>, and Impact increases by 0.4, up to a maximum increase of <color=#2BAD00>40</color>.
After <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off</color> hits an enemy affected by <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color>, it triggers <Term:1000038></Term>, reverting <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> back to its original state.
When any squad member triggers <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Cleanse</color>, Roxy provides all squad members with a buff based on the attribute of the <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> or <color=#FFFFFF>Cleanse</color> effect: for every 1% CRIT Rate Roxy has, when non-<color=#FFFFFF>Armorer</color> characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their CRIT DMG increases by 0.4%, up to <color=#2BAD00>22%</color>. When <color=#FFFFFF>Armorer</color> characters deal DMG of the corresponding attribute or Wind DMG, their Laceration DMG increases by 0.2%, up to <color=#2BAD00>10%</color>. Each attribute's buff lasts 50s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
When <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color> is applied again to an enemy already in the <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color> state, all squad members can also gain this buff based on the <color=#FFFFFF>Contamination</color> attribute of the overwritten <color=#FFFFFF>Windswept</color> state and Wind attribute.
